# Birdy's personal GoFundMe — review draft

Jordan selected **routine care and adventures**. This is a personal fundraiser; do not label it a rescue, nonprofit, veterinary emergency, or already-funded campaign. No campaign has been created or linked to the site.

## Proposed title

Help Birdy Keep Exploring — Everyday Care & Adventures

## Proposed story

Hi, I'm Jordan, and this is Birdy — my red heeler and brown Lab mix, my co-pilot, and the face behind iambirdy.com.

I've collected lots of photos of the places Birdy has been. I'm bringing them together into a journal so you can meet her, see those places, and read the stories behind the pictures.

This personal fundraiser would help with Birdy's everyday care and the costs of our outings. Before launching, I'll add a clear budget here: the expenses it covers, the time period, and the amount we're hoping to raise. There is no emergency medical claim behind this request.

[Replace this paragraph with the approved USD goal, period, actual expense breakdown, and who will receive/manage the funds. Explain any travel expenses distinctly from routine dog care.]

[Add the approved update schedule and how changes to the budget or use of funds will be explained.]

If you'd like to be part of Birdy's next chapter, thank you. Visiting the journal or sharing a favorite photo is appreciated, too.

— Jordan & Birdy

## Launch handoff

1. Confirm target amount, period, actual expenses, organizer/recipient, and update plan.
2. Choose an actual Birdy cover photo. The existing portrait is available; new album photos were not accessible in this browser.
3. Use the owner's GoFundMe account. Complete any identity/transfer setup privately; no credentials, bank details or identification documents in GitHub.
4. Owner handles legally binding terms and any account/financial verification. Review the final story and budget, then publish.
5. Verify the resulting public URL and organizer, purpose, and goal match the approved draft.
6. Add a simple outbound `Support Birdy` link to the site, with `rel="noopener noreferrer"` if opening a new tab. No third-party payment scripts, fake progress meter, or donation confirmation on the static site.
